lines.text: The root is Lect! Collect, select.
Lect is Latin for gather or choose.
Quick quiz! Which means apart plus gather?

data.src_mean: to gather, to read, to choose

words.ex: I'll collect you from the airport.
Select your seat when you book the flight.

publish.title: Lect root: collect and select
publish.value: Lect comes from Latin "legere" (to gather, to read, to choose). Words: collect and select. collect = col + lect; select = se + lect.
